name: Client
text: Client: Customer organization receiving an FDE solution. Properties: client_id, name, industry

name: Project
text: Project: Forward deployed engineering delivery engagement with delivery status, progress and go-live date. Properties: project_id, name, status, progress, planned_progress, days_to_go_live

name: Employee
text: Employee: Delivery team member assigned to projects and possessing technical or domain skills. Properties: employee_id, name, role

name: Skill
text: Skill: Technical or domain capability possessed by an employee or required by a project. Properties: skill_id, name, category

name: Risk
text: Risk: Delivery risk or blocker that may affect a project or milestone. Properties: risk_id, title, severity, status

name: Milestone
text: Milestone: Delivery checkpoint such as UAT completion or production go-live. Properties: milestone_id, name, type, status

name: DELIVERED_FOR
text: Project DELIVERED_FOR Client: project is delivered for a client

name: WORKS_ON
text: Employee WORKS_ON Project: employee is assigned to a project

name: HAS_SKILL
text: Employee HAS_SKILL Skill: employee possesses a skill

name: REQUIRES
text: Project REQUIRES Skill: project requires a skill for successful delivery

name: HAS_RISK
text: Project HAS_RISK Risk: project has an identified delivery risk

name: BLOCKS
text: Risk BLOCKS Milestone: risk blocks or threatens a milestone

name: HAS_MILESTONE
text: Project HAS_MILESTONE Milestone: milestone belongs to a project

name: OWNS
text: Employee OWNS Risk: employee owns mitigation of a risk

name: SkillGap
text: SkillGap: A project has a skill gap when it REQUIRES a Skill and no Employee who WORKS_ON that Project HAS_SKILL that Skill

name: GoLiveThreat
text: GoLiveThreat: An open CRITICAL Risk is a go-live threat when it BLOCKS a Milestone whose type is GO_LIVE
